name: @operon/alchemy
description: Alchemy program that provisions Operon cell Postgres 17 in Docker

scripts.plan: umask 077 && mkdir -p .alchemy && chmod 700 .alchemy && alchemy plan --stage local
scripts.up: umask 077 && mkdir -p .alchemy && chmod 700 .alchemy && alchemy deploy --stage local --yes
scripts.down: umask 077 && mkdir -p .alchemy && chmod 700 .alchemy && alchemy destroy --stage local --yes
